dict.string: Teleprompter Studio uses the camera to show your live preview under the scrolling script and to record your takes.
Teleprompter Studio uses the microphone to record audio with your video takes.
Teleprompter Studio saves your finished recordings to your Photos library.
Teleprompter Studio uses your local Wi-Fi network to mirror the prompter to a second device and to let you edit scripts from a browser on the same network. No data leaves your network.
